purpose: detect collision holes inside otherwise valid floor-like meshes by physics-sampling the actual runtime collision surface

geometry_policy.legacy_winding_policy: absolute normal Y; runtime ray uses hit_back_faces=true
geometry_policy.support_semantics: nearest runtime collision may be at or above the visual surface; only support more than 1.0 Y unit below the visual triangle is a fall-through-class failure

pass_requires: every non-exempt floor-like triangle produces four interior support samples
no nearest runtime support lies more than 1.0 Y unit below the visual triangle
collision above a visual triangle is classified as occupied/obstructed player space rather than a floor hole
known interactable/decorative horizontal faces are explicitly non-walkable semantics, not silently ignored by area/normal thresholds
complements: PPPV v2 input-driven room transition scenarios
evidence_boundary: Source contract does not prove runtime collision coverage. Candidate 4 preflight requires asset-backed Godot v121 PASS at the exact build SHA.
